title: Sanitization
description: The deterministic record of what sanitize() removed from a payload before delivery. Carried as `inspection` on a SealedEnvelope and committed by hash into the signed CallReceipt.

modified.description: True if any string in the payload was altered.

findings.description: One entry per category of neutralization applied to one string field, sorted by path then kind.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the affected string field.

kind.description: The category of character removed or normalized.
